description: This file defines a Session class for managing user sessions within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles session lifecycle processes such as starting a session, retrieving session ID, closing, destroying, and garbage collection by interacting with various session adaptors.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Class for managing user session lifecycle including creation, retrieval, destruction, and cleanup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session object, loads the appropriate session adaptor class, and registers shutdown functions for cleanup.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins a session with a new or existing session ID, validating the ID and loading session data.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the current session data from storage.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection on session data.
